messages.author: bfc2eb6b71169017
messages.subject: Re: help
parts:
geom_point() draws data points and geom_smooth() draws a line that best describes the data. This function (geom_smooth) can appropriate the power of different modeling functions like glm, gam and loess.

See http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/stat_smooth.html for more information

Cheers,
Roman

messages.author: 2710b717e5dbb066
messages.subject: Re: help
parts:
I remember reading a humorous, but somewhat informative, story about a
retired geneticist who lived near a car manufacturing plant and
decided to learn more about how the process of making cars worked.
Each morning he would ambush an employee and tie their hands together,
then observe how the cars made that day differed from before, e.g. if
the cars were missing the front and rear windshields then he knew that
the employee ambushed that day was responsible for their installation.

The same idea can apply to learning about constructs like you are
asking about. Try running the command as shown, then try it without a
part and see what changes, then try it without another part, etc. You
should gain valuable insight from seeing what is missing in the plot
when you remove part of the command.

If all else fails, read the documentation.
Avoid the feeling of failure and read the documentation first.
